15: Supplementary Fig. S15. Random-reference calibration distinguishes non-random structure from operational fidelity. a-d, Local neighbour overlap, trustworthiness, global distance-rank correlation and same-label neighbour fraction for nine methods on matched 1,000-cell subsets of PBMC3k, Paul15 and heart atlas. Blue, green and purple points identify datasets. Grey bars span central 95% intervals from 1,999 unrestricted permutations; grey ticks mark null means. Coloured translucent bars show annotation-conditioned geometry nulls in a-c and donor-conditioned label permutations for heart in d. Dashed lines mark unchanged operational cutoffs of 0.30, 0.90, 0.45 and 0.55. Local overlap is the shared fraction of 15 nearest neighbours; trustworthiness penalises embedding-only neighbours; global rho compares distance ranks across 5,000 non-self pairs; label fraction measures annotation agreement. e, f, Observed pseudotime-distance rho and local pseudotime retention under four expression-reference diffusion pseudotime roots. 8Mk, 7MEP, 9GMP and 1Ery denote megakaryocyte, megakaryocyte-erythroid progenitor, granulocyte-monocyte progenitor and erythroid annotations. Retention is one minus neighbour-to-random-pair mean pseudotime difference. Numbers and colour show observed scores; asterisks denote upper-tail q < 0.05 relative to coarse-lineage-conditioned permutations. g, Normalised heart donor entropy, with observed points and central 95% intervals from donor permutations within cell types. All nine lower-tail deficit tests have q = 0.0005. Donor deficits identify donor association, not technical-batch causality. Probabilities use the plus-one Monte Carlo estimator and separate Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment within each null family. Null intervals are not confidence intervals; cells, pairs and permutations are not biological replicates. scVI is unsupervised and donor-unconditioned. Full effects, probabilities, denominators and cutoff decisions are reported in Supplementary Table S15.
